visual_action: A montage of video clips shows large crowds of people marching in a pro-choice protest, likely in Washington D.C., as indicated by views of the Washington Monument, the U.S. Capitol, and the Supreme Court building. The protesters carry a variety of signs with slogans advocating for abortion rights, such as "MY BODY MY CHOICE" and "BANS OFF OUR BODIES."

cast.name: The Supreme Court
cast.evidence: On-screen text states, "The Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade through Dobbs v. Jackson".

cast.name: Republican Party
cast.evidence: On-screen text reads, "Extreme Republicans across the country are pushing for an abortion ban nationwide."

cast.name: Unnamed pro-choice protesters
cast.evidence: The video consists entirely of footage of diverse crowds of people marching in a protest for abortion rights.

on_screen_text.text: The Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade through Dobbs v. Jackson
Since then, fourteen states have banned most abortions
two states have implemented six-week abortion bans
Many of these states have extreme bans, with no exceptions for rape and incest
Extreme Republicans across the country are pushing for an abortion ban nationwide
This is your reminder that the majority of Americans supported Roe v. Wade
TODAY WE MARCH, TOMORROW WE RUN FOR OFFICE!

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video; it is set to instrumental music.
audio_music: A slow, somber piano instrumental, which sounds like a cover of "Where Is My Mind?" by the Pixies, plays consistently throughout the video, creating a serious and reflective tone.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage of different clips from a protest, edited with deliberate, slower-paced cuts that match the somber musical score.
cultural_references: The background music is an instrumental version of the song "Where Is My Mind?" by the Pixies.
A sign reads "I'M WITH HER," a slogan famously associated with Hillary Clinton's 2016 presidential campaign.
central_claim: One year after the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, Republicans are escalating their efforts to ban abortion nationwide, threatening rights supported by the majority of Americans.
intended_effect: To evoke concern and a sense of urgency about the state of abortion rights, and to motivate viewers to oppose Republican-led efforts to further restrict abortion access.
